name: add a classification benchmark task to an lm-eval harness (wire data, match accuracy)
definition: Install/logi harness package, add a multiple-choice classification task wired to data and gold labels, and match accuracy windows.
failure_mode: wrong choice order or gold mapping skews accuracy outside the windows

name: apply a supplied per-line defect-repair request
definition: Send explicit fix requests for each located line so every defect is corrected, staying within a small fix budget.
failure_mode: Too many fix attempts causes the run to fail the success check.

name: author a python package exposing a given function from its root module
definition: Structure a small package so the entry module defines a function computing a scalar product of two numeric sequences.
failure_mode: Wrong import path or absent function fails the import/API test.

name: avoid leak-suppression workarounds
definition: Ensure the corrected lifecycle actually runs static/global destructors instead of short-circuiting program exit so a leak checker finds no definite leaks.
failure_mode: A fix using any 'exit-without-cleanup' hack (or that leaks) fails the valgrind test.
